nodes.label: ADR-006: Deterministic Presence Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Presence (session mode, return state, elapsed gaps, continuity) is computed by local deterministic rules instead of runtime cognitive inference: deterministic logic runs in under a millisecond, incurs no token cost, and yields reproducible thresholds where a probabilistic model would be inconsistent. Threshold changes move to local configuration rather than prompt edits. Status: Proposed.

nodes.label: Offline-First Resilience
nodes.rationale: A core system principle: presence calculations must stay fully active in isolated environments with zero connectivity, which rules out any external intelligence call on the hot path.
